note: Ground truth: the window census (docs/experiments/window-census.md on branch fund-window) and, for class A, KiCad's DRC accepting the single-net path whyopen.py --verify wrote (build/scratch/fund-eval/all/causes.json). Classes: A a legal path for the net alone exists with all other copper kept; B walled by other nets' routed copper; C walled at a pad by fixed objects of the input or by the class's width; D a piece of the net's pour; E not local. Three classes were revised after round 1 by direct checks (the field revised says how); census_class keeps the first key.

cases.truth: dead pad IC2.11: the +12V class's 2.0 mm track is wider than the pad's surroundings admit (the router's dead_pads: no node within 2 mm admits the class's track)
cases.revised: KiCad accepts a 0.4 mm F.Cu track of 2.0 mm from IC2.11 to the +12V pad C15.2 beside it (unconnected 6 to 5, no new error; build/scratch/fund-eval/try/sumec-neck): a single-net miss of the router's neck rule, which wants a full-width node within 2 mm. The census class (walled-dead) and the first dossier (class_width_does_not_fit) were both wrong; two subjects found it.
